items.title: YoloLiv Mozi: AI camera and lighting control
items.excerpt: YoloLiv Mozi adjusts the YoloCam S3 and up to four lights from a reference image or prompt. The Early Preview is open now.
items.rationale: New hardware-plus-AI product: you set camera and lights by matching a reference image or typing a prompt. The Early Preview is open now, so small crews can try it right away.

items.title: How to Make Pro-Level AI Animation (Complete Guide)
items.excerpt: Learn how to make pro-level 2D animation with AI. Albert Bozesan breaks down the workflow he uses to make his animated sitcom Tarmac, from building reusable ...
items.rationale: A fresh, step-by-step guide to the workflow behind a real animated series (reusable characters and assets). Highly actionable for creators.

items.title: 4BY4's AI PIXELL Upscales Three AI Films to 4K for Theater Screening in Seoul
items.excerpt: Korean content AI company 4BY4 used its AI PIXELL solution to enhance and upscale three AI films to 4K for THE COLLABORATION 2026, a project pairing seven Korean film directors with nine AI directors. The films screen at CGV Apgujeong on Nov. 27.
items.rationale: A follow-up with a concrete new deployment: PIXELL took three AI-generated films to 4K for a cinema screening. This answers the 'delivery' problem of AI film output reaching theaters.

items.title: The Chroma Awards Are Back as ElevenLabs' Flagship Competition for AI Creators is Live
items.excerpt: Celebrate the best AI-made work in film, music videos, ads, games, and behind-the-scenes content and enter for the chance to win $450,000+ in cash and travel prizes now until January 7th, 2027.
items.rationale: An open call with a concrete deadline (Jan 7, 2027) and a $450K+ prize pool across film, music video, ad and BTS categories. Creators can act on it now.

items.title: Rian Johnson, a Vocal AI Critic, Warns Against Totally 'Demonizing' AI and Says His 'Poker Face' Revival With Peter Dinklage Is Dead
items.excerpt: Rian Johnson talks status of his Warner Bros. deal, AI and his new sci-fi thriller, while confirming that Peter DInklage's Poker Face revival is dead.
items.rationale: A notable shift from a prominent AI critic toward a more nuanced stance, which helps read where Hollywood sentiment is heading. Fifth distinct outlet.

https://www.kentertechhub.com/4by4-ai-pi.new_action: 4BY4 deployed AI PIXELL to upscale three AI films to 4K for the theatrical screening at CGV Apgujeong. This is a new vendor deployment, distinct from the 11-15 PIXELL Mac/Resolve/Nuke release card and the 11-27 ElevenLabs audio-partner card.
